messages.content: Hello! I am your Product Manager for SiteAudit Pro. I have reviewed the discovery log from our Business Analyst. We are solving the core pain: manual clipboard transcription results in a 15% error rate in structural safety logs, lost photo context, and delayed critical hazard notice... I have prepared the complete, grounded Product Requirement Document (PRD) adhering strictly to the handbook standard. You can review the full PRD and the stage-by-stage token and cost estimates below.

scores.evidence: Found 2 unique features. Must-have FR coverage: 2/2.
Found 4 unique ACs with 6 Given/When/Then clauses across 2 features. Vague terms present: False.
Detected 2 explicit (unhappy path) criteria across 2 features.
Non-goals table (NG-###) present with rationale and source citations.
Success metrics with numeric targets and telemetry/query measurement methods present.
Clean separation of FRs and NFRs.
All roles, claims, and numbers strictly grounded in discovery answers.
Timeline and budget cited with scope trade-off reasoning.

judge_verdict.verdict_summary: PRD PASSED Judge audit with score 24/24.
